data.title: Reincarnator’s Stream
alt_titles: Buổi Phát Sóng Của Kẻ Trùng Sinh
data.description:
Narukami Subaru, the strongest player and the Master of Lightning, was betrayed and killed by a trusted friend while conquering the Tower. After using up all his power to save his comrades, he dies. Yet somehow, fully aware of his own death, he opens his eyes to find himself reincarnated 20 years in the future. The truth is buried, and the traitor, Kyojo Itsuki, now reigns as the top player of this new era. To take revenge and reach out to the comrades who might still be waiting for him, Subaru knows he has to get stronger, fast.

"I can't do things the same way as before."

Given a second chance, the former strongest chooses an unexpected path: live streaming!

Despite the industry overflowing with streamers shamelessly copying the legendary Narukami Subaru, he couldn't care less.

"It doesn't matter, because I'm the real one."
data.author: Black Ajin

data.description:
On a battlefield at the brink of annihilation, unknown soldier Gray Lee had his chest pierced through—and he awaited death.

Only humanity's strongest heroes—the Sword Saint, the Divine Archer, the Great Sage, and the Ultimate Shield—stood a chance against the "Liquidator," a deadly enemy capable of burning down an entire continent in a single day.

Yet even those heroes fell, one by one, until all hope was lost...

...At least, that's what it should've been.

"I got pierced through the heart, but I'm still alive?"

Gray did not die. Instead, he was guided by Chronos, the Master of Time. He was bestowed an unknown power, and with it he delivered a powerful blow to the Liquidator, shaking the threads of fate itself.

But just as a chance of victory appeared, another beam of light struck, Gray's body reducing to nothing...

...and Chronos's voice thundered, "I shall send you to the past. Save this world."

The next thing Gray knew, he woke up in his hometown, which should long have been destroyed. It was the place he started his life of a loser—and was now the stage for his second chance.

"This time, I will survive!"

With the power to transcend time and his memories of the future, Gray sets out to become a warrior even stronger than the heroes.
data.author: Shinkou Shotou

data.title: The Hero Starts Over at the Academy
alt_titles: 元天才英雄、アカデミーでやり直す
Moto Tensai Eiyuu, Academy de Yarinaosu
data.description:
Misato Kyoichiro, the leader of the strongest group of adventurers, the "Golden Seekers," was betrayed by his comrades and left to die.

"I won't just die like this!!"

In his final moments, he activated a reincarnation spell. Kyoichiro successfully reincarnated twenty years later as a student named Asai Kyosuke, a wielder of the "Void" attribute.

"Void" is an attribute mocked for being "attributeless," but Kyoichiro knew the truth of this attribute, thanks to the "Time" attribute he had in his previous life.

The "Void" attribute has the potential to surpass the "Time" attribute, which was seen as the strongest in his lifetime.

Thus, reborn as Asai Kyosuke, he returns to the Adventurer Academy, determined to purge all evil from society; all to get revenge on his former comrades, who betrayed him out of greed.

And...

"Asai Kyosuke, I won't let anyone look down on you ever again."

...to reach the peak of strength, something he could not achieve in his previous life.
data.author: Amaike Nozomu

data.description: Makoto Kaneshiro, a former member of the Special Forces, had been spending his days engrossed in video games while struggling to find his place back into society. Suddenly, he receives an unexpected phone call. "Makoto Kaneshiro, is that you?" The caller possesses detailed knowledge of Makoto's personal information and gaming habits. Caught off guard, Makoto attempts to shut down his computer, but... to his dismay, he discovers the same situation repeating itself, again and again.

data.title: Return From The Abyss
data.description:
"I shall wait for you at the edge of the Abyss..."

That is what a mysterious man said to Sora Mukujima in one of his dreams.

Sora lived a modest life together with his parents, until one day, that peaceful life fell apart. A massive tower appeared. His brother, a soldier, was unreachable. And monsters began to attack suddenly.

When he was in a desperate situation, the man from his dream appeared before him.

And when he woke up next, he was in an unfamiliar place. It was a different world called the "Abyss", just as the man had called it in his dream.

In order to return to his original world and save his family, Sora vows to challenge the Abyss, fight, and grow stronger at all costs!
data.author: SANFU

data.title: Dungeon Defense
alt_titles: ダンジョンディフェンス
data.description: When his total scumbags of parents die, he finds himself with a mysterious inheritance of 500 million yen.Deciding to do whatever he likes from then on, the boy enters the most challenging online game, "Dungeon Attack," where he becomes the first to unlock the achievement of defeating all the Demon Lords. However, when he answers a mysterious question that appears after completing the game, he suddenly finds himself sent into the game world.He had been reincarnated as "Dantalian," the lowest and weakest Demon Lord, ranked 71st in the game world\! With nothing but his memory of defeating the strongest Demon Lord and his eloquence to rely on, he fights to survive in this brutal world - this is a story of comeback and revenge\!
